annotations.text:
Amber = the model's reading. Teal = your data and pure arithmetic.
Every screen keeps that split — it is the plan's core rule made visible, so a user can always see which numbers were read and which were computed.
The confirm sheet carries all five quantity states in one screen: counted (roti), personal unit (a bowl), low confidence (which dal?), no amount given (curd), and fiber unknown shown as an em-dash.
Every artboard has a Dark toggle in the chips above it — the palette is the same one the plan and flows documents use.
